search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=mscs:*:log | stats count by host|table host

index=_introspection $host$ source=*resource_usage* component="PerProcess" data.args=*mscs* | stats sum(data.pct_memory) as memory_sum, sum(data.normalized_pct_cpu) as cpu_sum by _time | timechart p99(memory_sum) as "Memory Usage P99", p90(memory_sum) as "Memory Usage P90", p75(memory_sum) as "Memory Usage P75"

index=_introspection $host$ source=*resource_usage* component="PerProcess" data.args=*mscs* | stats sum(data.pct_memory) as memory_sum, sum(data.normalized_pct_cpu) as cpu_sum by _time | timechart p99(cpu_sum) as "CPU Usage P99", p90(cpu_sum) as "CPU Usage P90", p75(cpu_sum) as "CPU Usage P75"
